items.title: File Einspruch against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterwolgast ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Bescheid is dated 20.11.2026 (Friday) and sent by post. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (as amended since 2025, consistent with the letter's own statement 'Bekanntgabetag der vierte Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post'), notification (Bekanntgabe) occurs on the 4th day after posting: 20.11.2026 + 4 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). That day is a regular business day (no weekend/holiday adjustment needed), so Bekanntgabe = 24.11.2026. The Einspruchsfrist is one month from Bekanntgabe (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO). Per § 108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the triggering event (24.11.2026) is not counted; the period runs from 25.11.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day, i.e. 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24.12.2026 is not a statutory public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (Heiligabend is not a legal holiday there), so the deadline stands on that day.
